pages.title: FAQ – CloudSync Pro
pages.html:
{CloudSync Pro}

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about CloudSync Pro's features, billing, setup, and support. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.

Getting Started

CloudSync Pro is a cloud-based file synchronization and collaboration platform that keeps your files, documents, and project data seamlessly synced across all your devices. Whether you're working from your desktop, laptop, tablet, or smartphone, your files are always up-to-date and accessible from anywhere with an internet connection.

Our platform supports team collaboration, version control, and real-time notifications, making it ideal for professionals and businesses of all sizes.

Getting started is simple: visit our website, click "Sign Up," and create a free account with your email address. Download the CloudSync Pro app for your device (available for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android), log in with your credentials, and you're ready to start syncing. Your first 5GB of storage is free, and you can upgrade anytime.

Yes! CloudSync Pro is available for Windows (7 and later), macOS (10.12 and later), iOS (13 and later), and Android (6.0 and later). You can also access your files through our web portal from any browser without installing anything.

Features

Absolutely! CloudSync Pro makes sharing easy. You can generate shareable links for individual files or entire folders, set expiration dates, require passwords for access, and control whether recipients can edit, comment, or view only. You can also invite team members to collaborate on shared folders in real-time.

Yes, CloudSync Pro automatically maintains version history for all files. You can restore any previous version of a file from up to 180 days ago (depending on your plan). Simply right-click a file, select "Version History," and choose the version you'd like to restore. This is invaluable for recovering from accidental changes.

Yes, security is our priority. All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256 encryption. We also offer optional end-to-end encryption where only you hold the encryption keys. CloudSync Pro is GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type II compliant, meeting the highest industry standards.

Billing

Free Plan: 5GB storage, basic file syncing, sharing with link generation.

Pro Plan: $9.99/month, 2TB storage, advanced sharing controls, version history up to 180 days, priority support.

Business Plan: $19.99/month per user, unlimited storage, team collaboration tools, admin controls, advanced security features, phone support.

Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing, custom storage limits, dedicated account manager, single sign-on (SSO), API access.

You don't need a trial—our Free Plan gives you 5GB of storage permanently at no cost. If you'd like to test our paid features before committing, we offer a 14-day free trial of our Pro Plan with full access to premium features. No credit card required to start the trial.

Yes, there are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. You can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings. If you cancel mid-month, you'll have access until the end of your billing period. Your data remains available for 30 days after cancellation, giving you time to download anything you need.

Troubleshooting

Here are the most common solutions:

Check your internet connection: CloudSync Pro requires an active internet connection. Try restarting your router or connecting to a different network.

Restart the app: Close CloudSync Pro completely and reopen it. Sometimes a fresh start resolves temporary sync issues.

Check available storage: If your device is out of storage space, files can't be synced locally. Free up some space and try again.

Verify account status: Make sure your subscription is active and your account hasn't been suspended.

Check file permissions: Some files or folders may be restricted by system permissions. Ensure the CloudSync Pro app has permission to access your files.

If problems persist, contact our support team at support@cloudsyncpro.com with details about which files aren't syncing.

Phone: +1 (800) 123-4567
